gbm_population_evidence.quote: A patient with high-grade (WHO grade IV) glioma diagnosed pathologically

candidate_evidence.quote: Neoadjuvant Temozolomide Combined With Simultaneous IMRT for Treatment of Glioblastoma
The patient received neoadjuvant temozolomide combined with simultaneous increase in intensity-modulated radiotherapy.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients undergoing surgery for the first time
Patients with recurrent glioma who have previously undergone surgery or radiotherapy and chemotherapy

role_evidence.quote: New auxiliary TMZ period: oral TMZ 75mg/m2, qd, continued until the beginning of radiotherapy.
Neoadjuvant Temozolomide Combined With Simultaneous IMRT for Treatment of Glioblastoma

coder_notes: Temozolomide is given in both arms; the experimental arm adds a neoadjuvant TMZ period and a shorter SIB-IMRT schedule, so TMZ schedule differs between arms (rule 6 exception) -> established_therapy_experiment; in the CRT comparator arm TMZ is standard Stupp. Intervention registered as Combination Product with 'other names: Intensity-Modulated Radiotherapy'. Population: conditions say Glioblastoma, inclusion says WHO grade IV glioma with no IDH requirement -> historical terminology. Primary outcome ORR by RANO.
